items.title: Trigram Campaign Impersonates About 50 AI and Blockchain Brands to Target Devs with Infostealers
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.summary: Artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, and logistics sectors across Europe and the U.S. have emerged as the target of a large-scale, industrialized campaign dubbed Trigram. "Trigram is a large-scale campaign that impersonates about 50 brands in the blockchain and AI sectors, to trick developers into executing an infostealer themselves," Stormshield said in a deep-dive technical report

items.title: Hackers Found a Way Around GitHub SHA Pinning. This Webinar Explains How to Close the Gap
items.author: info@thehackernews.com (The Hacker News)
items.summary: Pinning GitHub Actions to an exact version of their code, known as SHA pinning, has become the go-to defense against software supply chain attacks. Attackers have already found a way around it. In March 2026, the hackers who hijacked Trivy, a widely used open-source security scanner, planted malicious code that looked like it came from GitHub's official checkout tool.
